svg.text: Three loops one way and two the other: the shape is the interval. The right ear is a sixteenth of a hertz sharp, so the
figure turns. It passes through the same shape every eight seconds; a whole turn takes sixteen.
A flat two-tone cousin of the channel's mark, not the mark itself: the mark runs three frequencies, 3:4:6, in three
dimensions. The sound and the picture are the same two numbers.
